name: capa_agent
description: Selects Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs) for each anomalous sensor identified in the RCA output. Queries a Qdrant vector database for matching CAPAs based on severity level (Large/Moderate/Normal). Must be called after rca_agent.

skills.name: run_capa_selection
skills.description: Select Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs) for each root cause sensor in the RCA output using probabilistic selection from a Qdrant knowledge base. Requires the RCA output S3 bucket and key. Returns a CAPA output S3 URI with sensor-level corrective and preventive actions. Call this third, after rca_agent.
